name: Impossible Angles
introDiscord:
Architecture begins immediately committing crimes.

Stairs meet walls sideways.
Corners contain too many corners.
A doorway appears behind itself.

Shizuki wrote:

'I have officially stopped believing in geometry.'
introTwitch:
Architecture begins immediately committing crimes.

Stairs meet walls sideways.
Corners contain too many corners.
A doorway appears behind itself.

Shizuki wrote:

'I have officially stopped believing in geometry.'

impossible-angles-approach.prompt: Three impossible routes open across Impossible Angles.

left.message: Star Candies rest inside a corner with approximately five sides.

right.message:
A perfectly ordinary bench exists at an impossible 47-degree wall-floor.

Shizuki labeled it:

'NORMAL BENCH.

DO NOT QUESTION BENCH.

BENCH IS OUR FRIEND.'
right.fullHpMessage: You leave the restorative untouched. You're already at full health.

forward.message: An Angleweave Eel turns around a corner without actually turning.

impossible-angles-depths.prompt: Deeper within Impossible Angles, three paths bend through the unstable Nexus.

left.message: The Eel folds itself through an angle that should not fit an Eel.

right.message:
One Berry rests beside Shizuki's ruler.

The ruler has been snapped in half.

'MEASUREMENT TOOLS HAVE BETRAYED ME.'

forward.message: A cache is embedded in a wall that becomes the floor when touched.

impossible-angles-threshold.prompt: Near The Unclosed Triangle, three final routes cross the edge of reality.

left.message: A chest sits inside a triangle whose third side refuses to exist.

right.message: An Angleweave Eel emerges from the missing side.

forward.message:
A stable square of water restores your strength.

Shizuki's note:

'FOUR SIDES.

BEAUTIFUL.

I MISSED YOU.'
forward.fullHpMessage: You leave the restorative untouched. You're already at full health.

boss-antechamber.name: The Unclosed Triangle
boss-antechamber.prompt: The Unclosed Triangle rotates around an absent edge.

bossPromptDiscord:
The Unclosed Triangle rotates around an absent edge.

Something coils through the geometry itself.

Use /yes to enter or /no to preserve your remaining trust
in shapes.

bossRetreatText: You withdraw from The Unclosed Triangle. The impossible guardian will wait.

boss.revealText:
Space folds inward.

Fractured-Angle Coil reveals itself!

completionText:
The impossible structure relaxes.

For one glorious moment, every triangle has three sides.

Then Glimmer's old doodle appears on a fourth.
